security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown code fences, local documentation references, and anti-pattern headings. The only confirmed risks are three helper scripts that write report JSON to a user-supplied output path without overwrite safeguards. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed referenced files.

remediation.issue: User-controlled report output path can overwrite files.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output to a project reports directory, use exclusive file creation, or require confirmation before replacing an existing file.

content.user_title: Build Fullstack Apps with Senior Patterns
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent setup, architecture, and review guidance for modern web applications. This skill provides scaffolders, workflow references, and quality prompts for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL projects.
actual_capabilities: Lists setup commands for npm, pip, environment file creation, and local checks.
Documents React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, and cloud stack choices.
Provides three Python helpers that validate a target path and emit report output.
Summarizes architecture, workflow, performance, security, and maintainability practices.
Links reference guides for tech stack, architecture patterns, and development workflows.
limitations: The helper scripts are skeletal and do not scaffold complete production applications.
Reference guides contain placeholder patterns and need project-specific detail.
Commands are examples and may need adaptation before use.
The scripts can write report files when an output path is provided.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Foundation
use_cases.description: Define stack choices, setup steps, and review checkpoints for a new web product.

use_cases.title: Standardize Delivery Workflow
use_cases.description: Align quality checks, deployment commands, and architecture references across a team.

use_cases.title: Review Application Readiness
use_cases.description: Use the checklists to review security, performance, and maintainability before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Web App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack skill to outline a React and Node.js web app. Include stack choices, setup steps, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this repository with the skill guidance. Identify architecture, security, performance, and maintainability issues before implementation changes.

prompt_templates.title: Define Delivery Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a delivery workflow for a Next.js and PostgreSQL application. Include local setup, quality gates, deployment checks, and ownership boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a Production Stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the reference guides to assess a production fullstack system. Prioritize risks, remediation steps, testing gaps, and deployment safeguards.

output_examples.input: Plan a new SaaS dashboard with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
output: Recommended stack summary with frontend, backend, database, and deployment choices.
Setup sequence covering dependencies, environment files, local checks, and quality gates.
Review checklist for security, performance, maintainability, and release readiness.
Findings grouped by architecture, workflow, security, and maintainability.
Suggested next actions for tests, documentation, configuration, and deployment validation.

output_examples.input: Create a team workflow for a Next.js application.
output_examples.output: A practical workflow covering setup, implementation, quality checks, review ownership, and deployment verification.

best_practices: Review generated plans against existing repository conventions before changing files.
Run scripts on a test project before using them in production workspaces.
Confirm infrastructure commands target the intended local, cloud, or cluster environment.
anti_patterns: Running deployment commands from examples without checking context.
Treating placeholder reference content as a complete architecture decision.
Overwriting report files without reviewing the requested output path.

faq.question: Does this skill create a full application?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are basic helpers, and the documentation guides planning and review.

faq.question: Which stacks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and major cloud platforms.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Commands are documented examples or script entry points that require explicit execution.

faq.question: What should I review before running scripts?
faq.answer: Check the target path, output path, and whether the workspace contains production files.

faq.question: Is it ready for production architecture decisions?
faq.answer: Use it as a starting point. Replace placeholder guidance with decisions based on your system requirements.
